issue_context.title: Workaround flags for freeipmi-plugin
issue_context.body:
Hello! Please add workaround command line options to freeipmi-plugin connect for example to OCP servers

    ipmi-dcmi -D LAN -h 192.168.1.1 -u admin -p password --get-system-power-statistic --workaround-flags=noauthcodecheck

Without this flag I get following error

    freeipmi.plugin ERROR : MAIN : ipmi_monitoring_sensor_readings_by_record_id(): password verification timeout

review_comments: We are using only one of the possible representations for IPV6 `loopback`  here, please, add the [unicast representation](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4291#section-2.5.3) and the [IPV6 notation](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4291#section-2.4).

Well, these checks are for the _most common_ cases, not for every corner case. If the user misconfigures the plugin he gets an error message from the `libipmimonitoring` library itself (but it's not as clear as our error message). My intention was to shorten [the list of addresses]( https://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/freeipmi.git/tree/common/miscutil/network.c#n271) to check.
